contract: Repair the cache so a fresh online-mode query whose observer mounts and unmounts entirely offline does not later call its signal-consuming query function with a live signal after reconnect, regardless of refetchOnReconnect. Preserve supported behavior: multiple observers can share a fetch; unconsumed active work may finish into the cache after its observer leaves; consumed work can be aborted; cancellation restores prior query data and status and settles its originating attempt; late completion cannot publish as a newer attempt. Keep the supported query interfaces, dependencies, and build/test configuration. Change product source only. The reported defect constrains the offline-unmounted query's post-reconnect invocation; it does not establish a general ban on post-reconnect queries.

unknowns: The source does not establish that every paused, unstarted attempt must be physically aborted, nor that every post-reconnect query invocation is prohibited.
The exact settlement mechanism for an offline-unmounted, never-invoked attempt is not specified by the task.
